desktop_v1.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. This is an original high-fidelity static product design review for FlowSplice PTY, a real private remote terminal app, not a landing page. The attached image is ONLY the existing app icon to insert at tiny normal app-icon size; preserve its mint terminal ribbon. Do NOT make a logo poster. Create a complete design board at very high resolution, preferably 3840x1440. Two equal macOS windows side by side, each about 1680x1050 with accurate macOS traffic lights, flat straight-on orthographic UI, no device perspective, no hands. Modest board margins on neutral background. Outside the windows a restrained title and '界面概念稿 · 示例数据'. No giant marketing heading. Clear crisp readable Chinese interface typography, professional compact density, fine separators, primary text at realistic 14-16pt, monospace terminal at 15pt. No glass, gradients, huge card padding, decorative graphs or fake metric dashboard.
Product semantics must hold: one preconfigured target '我的 Mac', service '终端'. NO host picker, no add host, no SFTP, no keys/vault, no history/audit, no AI, no split panes, no terminal delete/kill button. A remote tmux session is distinct from a local terminal tab. Mac has full physical keyboard, NO virtual keys anywhere.
LEFT window: the full standalone '会话' management page, connected to 我的 Mac. Compact top actions search, refresh icon, primary '+ 新建会话'. A well-designed compact list with 3 realistic rows: '终端 · df238637' / '今天 09:12' / '此 Mac · 读写' / button '继续'; '终端 · 9a12c7de' / '今天 08:40' / 'iPad mini 正在写入' / button '只读加入'; '终端 · 4be81a90' / '昨天 22:18' / '无人写入' / button '打开'. Full UUIDs never prominent. A restrained note '关闭标签后，会话仍在远端保留'. The primary action is clearly new session, not enroll/disconnect.
RIGHT window: full standalone terminal work page. Active terminal title 'df238637', another open terminal '9a12c7de' with a small eye icon and text '只读'. Current mode compact but visible '读写 · 此 Mac', connected indicator, overflow menu. Terminal takes at least 80% of usable content. Readable normal zsh output using host generic 'me@mac', commands 'pwd', 'ls', 'git status', a realistic text-only shell transcript of about 20 short lines, cursor ready at a prompt. No command/cwd telemetry in sidebar. Terminal is NOT a tiny widget below management forms. Settings access unobtrusive.

Direction A / 专注终端. Closest in usability to contemporary Termius horizontal navigation, but original FlowSplice identity. On terminal page hide management sidebar completely, allowing almost full-width terminal. Refined selected tab underline and thin separators. The two screenshots must clearly demonstrate switching between separate complete pages.

mobile_v1.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a new high-fidelity mobile companion board for the FlowSplice PTY desktop concept in the reference image. Preserve that concept's icon, typography feel, colors and navigation philosophy, but adapt it properly to phones. The reference is style guidance, not a poster to reproduce. Deliver 2560x1440 landscape, FOUR complete phone screens side by side, straight-on, equal size, modest thin black device outlines, no perspective. A small board heading 'FlowSplice PTY · 手机页面' and subtitle '界面概念稿 · 示例数据'. Each phone shows a DIFFERENT PAGE in one workflow, not one long web form. Legible accurate Chinese, minimal tasteful separators, touch targets realistically 44pt. Do not use placeholders/lorem ipsum, giant empty cards or decorative charts.
Phone 1 labeled '01 连接设置': normal navigation title '连接设置'. Small icon and '我的 Mac · 终端' (pre-bound, NOT a selector). Field label 'Relay 地址' with '192.0.2.10:7000', field '私钥密码' with dots, short note '用于保护本机私钥', clear primary '申请连接'. No usernames, no SSH keys, no target picker.
Phone 2 labeled '02 远端会话': connected management page title '会话'; tiny connected indicator '我的 Mac', search field and plus create action. Three rows: 'df238637' '今天 09:12 创建' '此设备 · 读写' '继续'; '9a12c7de' '今天 08:40 创建' 'Mac 正在写入' '只读加入'; '4be81a90' '昨天 22:18 创建' '无人写入' '打开'. Do not say last activity; only creation time exists. Bottom app navigation appropriate to direction. No session delete button, no fake CPU/memory data.
Phone 3 labeled '03 终端': a real focused full-screen terminal page, top back chevron plus 'df238637', visible compact '读写' status, switch-open-terminals icon and overflow. The terminal uses legible monospace command output 'me@mac ~ % pwd', '/Users/me', ls output and a ready prompt. Show software QWERTY keyboard in lower 35% and one compact useful accessory row above it: 'Esc', 'Tab', 'Ctrl', four arrow icons. Hide primary app bottom navigation while keyboard occupies this page. NO enormous reconnect/password controls above terminal.
Phone 4 labeled '04 接管确认': read-only terminal visible behind bottom sheet, '9a12c7de' and a visible '只读' chip at top. Sheet title '接管读写？', detail '当前写入设备：Mac', explanatory text '接管后，Mac 将切换为只读。', primary '接管读写', secondary '保持只读'. No keyboard while in read-only mode. The action changes writer ownership, never deletes or restarts the session.
Only illustrate existing core workflows and proposed UI organization. No history, audit, AI, SFTP, vault, broadcast, host folders, sync, biometric authentication or rename session.

Board title must include '多 Home 与命名会话 · 修订稿' and '示例数据'. This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of implemented software.
Confirmed new model: one app manages MULTIPLE authorized Home endpoints, can connect to several of them SIMULTANEOUSLY, and open named persistent tmux sessions across them. Each session belongs to one Home and has a human-readable NAME, creation time, MOST RECENT SUCCESSFUL ATTACH TIME, current ATTACHED CONNECTION COUNT and writer. UUIDs exist internally but are NOT primary labels. Client connections independent: changing tab never disconnects another Home. No SFTP, SSH vault, history/audit, AI, broadcast, split panes, monitor graphs, delete/kill session, or virtual keys.
